ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Art and Cultural Theory. Drawing upon the disciplines of Philosophical Aesthetics and Cultural Studies, the course explores the intersection between theories of art and theories of culture. Theories of art to be explored include the essence theories of imitation, expression, therapy, significant form, aesthetics, and communication as well as the open, the necessary and sufficient conditions theory that informs the institutional theory of art. Theories of culture to be explored are drawn from high culture, anthropology, semiotics, and critical theory. Throughout the dominant cultural forms explored are visual. Issues of gender, race, class and globalization are addressed as well as pre-modernism, modernism, and postmodernism.
